confidence_notes: Can Tho's food-price data was last updated in February 2026 and had only three contributors; the mid-range meal has a wide reported range. Cocktail and wine prices are rough multiples of local draft beer. Accommodation is a holistic estimate based on the supplied city comparisons.
comparable_city_reasoning: Can Tho is a regional Mekong Delta hub, with less visitor-driven lodging demand than Ninh Binh, Da Nang or Phu Quoc. I estimate basic and three-star rooms near the lower end of those comparisons, closer to Hue; dorm and private-room estimates fall within the supplied ranges.
